name: Churches and Convents of Goa
description: In Old Goa, once the capital of Portuguese India, a cluster of grand 16th- and 17th-century churches and convents rises from the green landscape near the Mandovi River. The Basilica of Bom Jesus holds the tomb of St Francis Xavier, which draws pilgrims from around the world. Their Manueline, Mannerist and Baroque styles were carried by missionaries across Asia.
